name: Railroad Emergency Notification (ENS)
spec: blue vertical rectangle with white legend REPORT PROBLEM OR EMERGENCY and a crossing ID number
meaning: Call the number to report a problem at a railroad crossing.

snippets.back: A financial settlement with the other crash parties may end the financial-responsibility suspension during its three-year period.
Being uninsured or missing the fifteen-day proof deadline results in a ninety-day suspension for a first occurrence and a one-year suspension for a second occurrence, according to the manual.
Exchange names, addresses, driver-license and plate numbers, telephone numbers and insurance-company names with other drivers after a crash.
Accumulating twelve points within twelve months or eighteen points within twenty-four months requires suspension or revocation despite personal hardship.
A points-based suspension or revocation does not offer a limited work-purpose license.
Drivers receive a warning when they reach half the point total that triggers suspension.
Violation-free driving and completion of a defensive-driving course can earn point credits; the course may be used for point reduction once in twelve months.
A provisional-license holder reaching six points in twelve months or nine points in twenty-four months must complete a division-approved driver-improvement course.
